Quantum 1.3.1 was certified on 2026-07-13. It pins **nucleus v1.2.0**, **quark v1.2.2** and **orbit v1.2.1**.

A patch release of the suite after Quantum 1.3.0: quark goes from v1.2.1 to v1.2.2 (patch), nucleus stays at v1.2.0 and orbit stays at v1.2.1.
